authenticity_review: The image exhibits strong visual fidelity with realistic lighting, shadows, and material rendering of metal sculptures. However, several minor AI artifacts prevent perfection: (1) slight warping in background window panes with inconsistent reflection patterns, (2) repetitive wood grain texture on pillars lacking natural variation, (3) subtle perspective distortion in foreground cobblestone pattern near bottom edge, and (4) minor structural ambiguity at leftmost elephant's trunk base where it connects to face, plus front leg merging subtly with cobblestones without clear hoof boundary. These defects are relatively mild (severity 1-2) and do not significantly compromise overall authenticity, but collectively justify a score below perfect.
